sections.title: What Is an ATS-Friendly Resume?
sections.content: An ATS-friendly resume is a resume whose text, headings, dates, skills, and other important details can be read in a predictable order by applicant tracking software. Use standard section names, selectable text, readable fonts, consistent dates, and a simple layout. ATS compatibility does not guarantee an interview; the resume still needs relevant, truthful content that matches the job.

sections.title: Best ATS Resume Format for Indian Freshers
sections.content: For a fresher, a simple single-column or otherwise clearly ordered layout can work well. Put contact information at the top, followed by a concise summary or objective, skills, projects or experience, education, and relevant certifications. Keep spacing and typography consistent and make sure the exported file preserves selectable text.

sections.title: How to Structure an ATS Resume
sections.content: Organize the document in a logical order so the reader can move from your identity and target role to evidence of your skills. For freshers, a practical structure is contact details, summary or objective, technical/professional skills, projects or internships, education, certifications, and relevant achievements. Adjust the order when the target job clearly prioritizes another qualification.

sections.title: How to Write ATS-Friendly Skills and Projects
sections.content: Projects are especially useful when professional experience is limited because they show how you applied your skills. For each relevant project, state the problem or purpose, technologies used, your specific contribution, and a concrete result when available. Keep descriptions concise and focus on decisions, features, scale, performance, or outcomes that are relevant to the job.

sections.title: ATS Resume Formatting Tips
sections.content: For a fresher, a simple single-column or otherwise clearly ordered layout can work well. Put contact information at the top, followed by a concise summary or objective, skills, projects or experience, education, and relevant certifications. Keep spacing and typography consistent and make sure the exported file preserves selectable text.

sections.title: Common ATS Resume Mistakes
sections.content: Common problems include overly complex layouts, missing role-specific keywords, unclear headings, inconsistent dates, excessive graphics, spelling errors, and unselectable text. Fix these by simplifying the structure, checking the job description, standardizing formatting, proofreading carefully, and reviewing the actual exported file rather than only the editable version.

faqs.q: Is a single-column resume better for ATS?
faqs.a: A single-column layout is generally a straightforward choice because it keeps the reading order simple and reduces potential parsing problems.

faqs.q: Which font is best for an ATS resume?
